title: 职位摘要：Atari、Supercell、Scopely、Zynga、Tripledot、Voodoo 等公司的人事变动与晋升
content:
Jobs digest: moves and promotions at Atari, Supercell, Scopely, Zynga, Tripledot, Voodoo and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Our jobs digest has all the recruitment news you need from across the mobile games business, all in one spot.
This column is sponsored by
FastSpring
.
FastSpring
: Global payments for your games from a partner you can trust with your players. Quickly launch a new web store, replace an existing D2C vendor, or add a redundant vendor at
fastspring.gg.
Atari
: Crossy Road creator
Matt Hall
has been named EVP of Atari Mobile, a newly-created role reporting directly to chairman and CEO Wade Rosen. Hall co-founded Hipster Whale, which Atari acquired, and
joined the company earlier this year
. He will oversee Atari’s mobile business, bring its PC and console games to mobile and take its mobile IP to web, PC and console.
Supercell
: Former Metacore CEO
Mika Tammenkoski
has joined Supercell as senior advisor following on from
Metacore’s acquisition by the Clash of Clans maker
.
There are plenty more former Metacore staff making the switch to Supercell now the deal is closed:
Daniel Pietschke
is a new AI engineer at Supercell,
Mikael Björke
and
Idaliina Laine
have both joined as client programmers and
Mimosa Kovero
joins as QA specialist.
Livia Antal
and
Henrik Sarimo
have also joined the Hay Day team as creative producers, having previously worked at Side Quest Growth and Metacore.
Topias Kokkinen
has also started a new role as Supercell’s live ops and monetisation lead after four years at Bain & Company.
Atari’s Matt Hall, Supercell’s Mika Tammenkoski, Topias Kokkinen, Livia Antal and Henrik Sarimo.
Scopely: Julie Kim
has been promoted to lead producer, and
Shay Nevo
has started as VIP account management team leader after five years at Playtika.
Zynga
:
Paul Chambers
has started as senior design director for new games at Zynga Trinity after co-founding Modma Games, and
Matt Branick
has joined as a business operations analyst after five years at Warner Bros. Games.
Tripledot
:
James Timmins
has been promoted and is now lead data scientist in the group AI team.
Supercell’s Daniel Pietschke, Mikael Björke, Idaliina Laine and Mimosa Kovero, plus Scopely’s Julie Kim.
Voodoo: Elif Ece Küskü
has joined as a publishing manager after an 11-month stint at Rollic.
Rollic
:
Ömer Vanlıoğlu
has joined as a game manager after a year at Procter & Gamble,
Alperen Uzun
has left Small Steps Games to start as a product specialist, and
Alp Akkaya
joins as a junior 2D artist after an internship at Good Job Games.
Loom Games
:
Gizem Karatas
is the new product manager, and
Ahmet Nurda O.
has started as a product specialist after two years at Gamegos.
Scopely’s Shay Nevo, Zynga’s Matt Branick, Voodoo’s Elif Ece Küskü, plus Rollic’s Ömer Vanlıoğlu and Alperen Uzun.
Gear Games
:
William S. Schmitt
has been appointed general manager after heading up OldNerd64 Productions as CEO.
Tactile Games
:
Mads Anthony
has joined as a gameplay programmer after three years at Aloha Games, and
Natalia Tereshchenko
has moved over from Innovecs, where she also worked as a level designer.
Mistplay
:
Thomas Ghiazza
has joined as director of business development for EMEA, leading growth of its LoyaltyPlay product across the region. He spent the previous five years at Ogury.
Xsolla
:
Laurent Munier
is the new VP of EMEA partnerships, leaving Ubisoft after five years.
Tripledot’s James Timmins, Mistplay’s Thomas Ghiazza, Xsolla’s Laurent Munier, Appcharge’s Ronen Morecki, plus AdSurge’s Vincent Bernardin.
Appcharge
:
Ronen Morecki
has joined as chief operating officer to lead payments strategy and scale its merchant of record platform. He co-founded ZooZ, was previously CTO of PayU and was most recently VP of payments at monday.com.
AdSurge
:
Vincent Bernardin
has joined new ad network AdSurge, which is built on Miniclip’s expertise and Tencent’s technology, as head of EMEA.
Bidease
:
Dock Kim
has joined as VP of business development after more than seven years at Moloco, where he led go-to-market, ran its revenue teams and oversaw supply partnerships. He will lead Bidease’s go-to-market across North America, LATAM and EMEA.
Rollic’s Alp Akkaya, Loom Games’ Ahmet Nurda O., Gear Games’ William S. Schmitt, plus Tactile’s Mads Anthony and Natalia Tereshchenko.
Appier
:
Sanam Lou
has joined as VP of global marketing, leading its marketing teams across EMEA, APAC and the US. She has more than 25 years of experience across ad tech, gaming and enterprise software.
